schema_notes.windows: [] means all hours on all days. A window whose 'to' is earlier than its 'from' crosses midnight and is anchored to the day it STARTS (e.g. sun-thu 23:00-07:00 = Sun 23:00 to Mon 07:00 ... Thu 23:00 to Fri 07:00). '24:00' means end of day. No supplier states clearly whether Fri 00:00-07:00 or Sun 00:00-07:00 counts.
schema_notes.discount_pct: Percent off the kWh (consumption/energy) charge only. Fixed charges (distribution, supply, kVA capacity) are never discounted.
schema_notes.excludes_holidays: true = the plan excludes holidays and holiday eves explicitly; null = the supplier does not say.
schema_notes.secondary_only: true = figures come from comparison sites quoting the supplier, because the supplier site/PDF could not be fetched (JS-only or robots-blocked).
schema_notes.status: current | unverified_current (supplier document exists or was reported, but it is missing from the October 2026 comparison lists)

regular_price_next_update: 2027-01-01 expected (tariffs update every Jan 1 and Jul 1 per Electricity Authority decision 78206)

fixed_charge.unit: ILS per month (a bi-monthly IEC bill shows about 2x)

capacity_kva.note: Connection size (kVA) x rate / 12, prorated by days in the month. No supplier discounts it.

price_source_notes: Bezeq Energy's tariff appendix 'נכון ליום 01/07/2026' reproduces the Electricity Authority tariffs (53.83 ag/kWh excl. VAT). Incl.-VAT figures calculated at 18%. The Authority's own tariff book (https://www.gov.il/BlobFolder/generalpage/tarriffbook/he/sefer_tariff_07_2026.pdf) exists, but its tables could not be extracted. Supermarker (2026-09-30) shows the same figures.

tou_tariff.name_he: תעו"ז מתח נמוך (תעריף עומס וזמן) – וולונטרי לצרכן ביתי
tou_tariff.applicability: No separate household TOU product exists. Households may opt in to the low-voltage TOU tariff (TOU meter required). It is mandatory for connections of 3x200A and up and for customers who used over 40,000 kWh in the previous calendar year. Minimum stay 1 year. Joining or leaving costs 105.02 ILS incl. VAT in some meter setups (per Supermarker, citing the IEC voluntary TOU page). Private-supplier windowed plans are generally NOT available to TOU customers.
tou_tariff.off_peak: All other hours, including all of Fri/Sat in transition and summer.
tou_tariff.holiday_rule: Holiday eves are treated like Friday and holidays like Saturday (the tariff-book block table pairs 'ו/ערב חג' and 'שבת/חג').

fixed_charge_monthly.applies_to: low voltage, connection below 3x100A, bi-monthly reading

tou_tariff.notes: Hour blocks come from Electricity Authority decision 63609 (2022-07-27, in force since the 2023 annual update). That decision's table lists a separate winter Friday peak (16:00-21:00), but its text says it was merged into 17:00-22:00, and it gives no winter Saturday hours. Supermarker (citing tariff book table 5.1-1) and water-energy.co.il say winter peak is 17:00-22:00 on all days, which is used here.

plans.provider_he: סופר פאוור (לשעבר אלקטרה פאוור / סופרגז פאוור)
plans.conditions: All hours, all days, any meter type. Discount on kWh consumption only. Customers entitled to the IEC social discount use it first on the first 400 kWh/month; the plan discount applies to consumption above that. Plan change free, once a month (self-service). Exit takes effect from the start of the next month. Per Supermarker, the 05/2026 sales agreement lets the company add an operating fee to the fixed charge (amount not published, 30 days' notice).

20% off the uniform residential tariff, 07:00-17:00, Sun-Thu ('בימים א'-ה''). Needs a continuous meter with at least half-hourly data (smart meter). A billing cycle with no continuous reading gets no discount. Residential customers only. Plan switch through a representative costs 19.90 ILS one-time. Cellcom may change the discount with prior notice. Fixed, distribution/supply and kVA charges are billed in full.
plans.source_date_note: No date printed. Document code 18819-0426-01 may mean 04/2026 (inferred). Supermarker checked it on 2026-10-02.

plans.conditions: 18% on Sun-Thu 14:00-20:00; other hours and the weekend at full tariff. Smart (continuous half-hourly) meter. Residential uniform tariff only. 19.90 ILS plan-switch fee through a representative.
plans.source_date_note: Text layer of the PDF is garbled. 18%, 14:00, 20:00 and 19.90 are legible, and the Sun-Thu wording is quoted by Supermarker (checked 2026-10-02). Document code 18289-0225-01 may mean 02/2025 (inferred).

plans.conditions: 15% between 23:00 and 07:00 the next day. The agreement PDF does not limit the days. Smart (continuous half-hourly) meter. 19.90 ILS plan-switch fee through a representative. Residential only.
plans.source_date_note: No date printed. Document code 18818-0426-01 may mean 04/2026 (inferred).

plans.conditions: 7.5% on the uniform residential tariff on Sun-Thu only, all hours. Fri and Sat are at full tariff. Private customers on the uniform residential tariff only. The PDF does not require a continuous meter, unlike the windowed plans. Supermarker and Shtipser say a basic meter is OK, while Kamazeole says smart only. 19.90 ILS plan-switch fee. TOU customers are moved to a 6% generation-component plan.
plans.source_date_note: No date printed. Document code 18923-0626-01 may mean 06/2026 (inferred).

plans.conditions: The monthly consumption-component charge sets the rate for the WHOLE month (not marginal tiers): up to 149 ILS gets 10%, 150-199 gets 8%, 200-299 gets 6%, 300+ gets 5%. discount_pct holds the 10% maximum. The PDF says the customer must have a continuous meter ('בעל מונה רציף'). Fixed and kVA charges are not discounted.
plans.source_date_note: Undated agreement summary still hosted by Cellcom. Ynet mentioned the plan on 2026-05-03. It is missing from Supermarker (2026-10-02), Kamazeole (2026-10-22) and Shtipser (2026-09-27), so it may be closed to new customers.

plans.conditions: All hours, all days, any meter, per ICE (2026-08-02) and EasySwitch (09/2026). Ynet (2025-02-06) gave it as 5% in year 1 and 6% from year 2. Cellcom's own documents were not found, and the current comparison lists do not include it. Probably a legacy plan.

6% all day on the variable (kWh) component. The customer's IEC bill must be on the uniform residential tariff. Available with a basic meter (basic-meter agreement v2 03/26). Bezeq may change the discount with 60 days' notice. Unused discount is not carried over or refunded.

Sun-Thu ('ימים א' עד ה'') 07:00-17:00, excluding holiday eves and holidays ('לא כולל ערבי חג וחג'). Holidays defined: Rosh Hashana (2 days), Yom Kippur, Sukkot day 1, Shemini Atzeret, Pesach days 1 and 7, Shavuot, Independence Day. The hours of a holiday eve are not defined. Needs a continuous remote-read meter with at least half-hourly data. Uniform residential tariff only. 60 days' notice for discount changes.

Sun-Thu 23:00-07:00, excluding holiday eves and holidays (same holiday list as the Day plan). The agreement does not say whether Thu-night hours after midnight (Fri 00:00-07:00) count. Smart meter required. Uniform residential tariff only.

Quoted from Partner's site via Supermarker: 5% in months 1-12, 6% from month 13 and 7% from month 25 after supply starts, all hours. Discount on the kWh rate only. Fees per Supermarker: standing-order handling 8.10 ILS/month (unclear whether it applies to credit-card payers), debit-authority setup 40.55 ILS, plan switch 4.90-59.90 ILS. Not for TOU customers. Leaving resets tenure (Kamazeole).
